gtsangakirti'idashonadu mtshananyid gsar 'dzugs mdzad/ dgung lo zhe bdun par mdzod dge'idamar mo thang du shing bza' rdo rje 'chang las dus 'khor dbang chen gsan/ dgung lo she brgyad par rnga pa kirti'idagonadu rgyud grwa gsar 'dzugs kyi sta gon dang stag tshang lha moradus 'khor grwa tshangagasar 'dzugs mdzad/ dgung lo zhedagur par stag tshangadapal gyi lha mo'i gdan sar dus 'khor dbang chen gyi thog ma de gnang zhing gdan sar sngags rams pa'i srol gsar 'dzugs mdzad/ dgung so/ nga gcig par sngags kyi bsdus don gsang chen bdud rtsi'i snying po dang dgung lo nga drug pa phyi 'o/ 1904 'o/ra byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i dmigs khrid skyodang tshul thar 'dod 'jug ngogs 'di ljags rtsom mdzad/mdorata/khri zura.a lags bstanapatshangadang /rdo rje 'changadaton mchog lhun lam/ sku/ngas 'dzin paṇḍita thub bstan mtha' yas pa sku/gas mtshan ldan dge ba'i bshes gnyenatwa ma'i drunganas mdo sngags rig gnas dang ris su ma chad pa'i gzhung lugs rgya mtsho lta buragasan bsamadapyis phyinapa mdzad de/ mkhas grubakṣa bral du ma sku/nga ba'i mdzad 'phrin bsamagyis mi khyab pas chos kyi rgyal srid chen por mngon par dbang bsgyur pasayul mdo smad kyi che rgu kun gyigatsug ginor bur gyur/ dgung song bdun pa shing sbrul 1905'o/ra mdzad pa'i mtha' ma bstan/rje de nyid kyi gsung 'bum wad bcu gnyis bzhugs pa'i nanganas lam rim 'di la 7skyabs mthon lam rim zhesasku/ngas su grags la/ phasalagyigadan sa gong 'og kunatu blo 'dzin gnang mkhan shinatu mang ba dang 'di ga kirti'i byesapa grwa tshang ginang blo 'dzin mdzad mkhan mang ca zhigayodana'angadape rgyun dkon stabasad lam deb gzugs 1/ga phyi so/ 2001 zla 5 tshes 1la 'phagasayul kirti'i byes pa grwa tshang nas dpar bskrun byasapacad//

da ka ra cha ga1) bshes gnyen bsten tshul dang 'brel ba'i gsol 'debs tshiṭa bcad// —12) zhal gdamā mgur ma/ zha3) rje dgung pho brgyad pa'i dus su mdzad pa'i lam rim 54) byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i dmigs khrid skyong tshul mdor bsdus thar 'do 'jug ngogs/ 85) lam yongs rdzogs kyi byin chas zhu ba'i gsol 'debs/ khe716) dam chos 'dzin pa'i so lam mam lam rim so lam/ 74

1bshes gnyen bsten tshul tshigs bcad bzhugs //༄༅༅/ na mo gu ru bhaḥ dam chos bdud ci'i bka' drin stsol mdzad pa'i/ /chos 'brel dngos thob drin can bla ma kun/ /rab 'byams rgyal kun 'dus pa'i snga rwab ru/ /mthong ba'i dad mos skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /dug gsum skyon gyis sbags pa'i ma dag khra'i/ /snang cha bla ma'i mdzad par shar ba la/ /skyon rtog skad cig tsam yang mi skye bar/ /dag snang rtsol med 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /spangs rtogs phyogs bcu'i rgyal kun dang mnyam yang / /tha mal gzugs kyis sku ngas the gas bstan pa'i gnad/ /'acanams pa'i bka' drin rgyal kun las lhag par//mthong ba'i mos gus skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /'phral gyi bde 'byor cung zad nas bzung ste/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub bar gyi legs tshogs kun/ /bla ma'i bka' drin kho na las 'byung bar//rtsegacig nges pa rnyed par byin gyis rlobs/ /lus srog yal bar bor ba'i bkur zhidang / /ci 'byor rnyed pa 'bul zhing khyad

2paratwa/ /ci gsung bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i mchod pa yis// phan bde'i mab tshugs par byin gyis rlobs/ /gang shar bla ma'i gsang gsum rnam rolatu/ /blta ba'i rnal 'byor zab mo mthar phyin te/ /rdo rje gsum dbyer med pa'i go 'phang mchog /tshe gcig nyid la thob par byin gyis rlobs/ rṣa bawogarnyobaca tshulagyitshigasabagobadinigus jobadagokhyoda'ajamadapalabasa'adzinanasabaskul ngor/ 7rong rṣa sprul ming pa rākhazang 'phrin las kyis sbyar ba dza ya /

zhal gdams ༷spror ma bzhugs sa/ko༅༅/dpal skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma rje'i//zhabs rdul phreng 'bral med gtsug gis bsten//gnas thar med srid pa'i rgya mtsho 'dir//res lha ri'i phun tshogs bde ba myong //res dmyal ba'i gnas na cho nge 'debs//dus da lta dal 'byor mi lus thob//thos bsam sgom byed pa'i skal ba ldan//gtan skyid dang gtan gyi sdug bsngal gnyis//gang 'dam gyi rang dbangayod pa'i tshe//gnyid bzang btung 'du 'dzi bromo'i gtam//yul rnam g.yeng za zi ban bun dang //tshe don med gzad pa'i mdo med po/khyod 'jigs med rdo rje'i sku brnyes sam//dus snyigs ma'i tshe thung zhag 'ga' tsam//dgra 'chi bdag bsu ma tshur tshur 'ongs/kho slebs tshe zlog par mi nus na//de'i lam rgyags tshags su tshud dam ci//dbugs rta rnga tsam 'di khrogagis chad//yul sna tshogs snang ba thibs kyis nub//rang gcig pur 'gro la chas pa'i tshe//da sems la 'dzin rgyu ci 'dug soms//tshe 'di snang bde sdug rmi lam bzhin//nor longs

4spyod gzhan gyi nor dang 'dra/ /grogs mdza' bshes 'du 'bral tshong 'dus mgron/ /lus 'di yang bzhag nas 'gro dgos na//rang gcig pu grogs med 'khyams pa'i tshe/ /skyabs bslu ba med pa bla ma lha/ /dgos dus su phan pa dam pa'i chos/ /'di kho na yin phyir da lta nas/ /chos mdo sngags gzhung gi gnad don la/ /bsam sgom gyis 'dris par ma nus kyang / /tshig sgra spyi tsam gyi 1nas pa yis/ /rgyud bag chags bzang wad pebs par mjodi/ /thozhe drilan da sum par srungs// skyabs bla ma lha la blo snying gtod/ /yongs sdig pa'i grogs po dgra ru ltos/ /tshe phyi ma ci 'gyur bsam blo thongs/ /rang sgo gsum khyod par bya ra gyis/ /dus nyin mtshanadonadang ldan par mdzod//tshul de skad smras pa'i dge ba yang / /ma 'gro kun sgrol ba'i rgyur gyur cig ces pa 'di ni don gnyer can 'ga' la phan phyir/g.yo gzugs thobazanga'aphrin las kyis sug bris su bgyis pa dzayacu/ /

5rje snyad dgung lobargyad pa'i dus su mdzad pa'i lam rim bzhugs lhag/༄༅༅/ bla ma dang thub dbang rdo rje 'chang dbyer med pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ dus thams cad du rjes su bzung du gsol/mtshan dang dpe byad rab tu rdzogs pa'i sku/ /yan lag drug cu'i dbyangs ldan gsung mnga' ba/ /shes bya thams cad legs par mkhyen pa'i thugs/ /shākya'i gtso wa de la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /'dir ni skal ldan rnam mkhyen sar bgrod pa/ /skye bo'i chos lugs byang chub lam rim 'dir/ /sdu dngagacig tu dril nas sems bzang gis/ /byang chub lam gyi rim pa 'di ltar bri/ /'di phyi'i legs tshogs thams cad 'grub pa'i gzhi//dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsam rjermor gnyis lha'inas/ /tshu la bzhin rab tu bsten na lam rtogs kun/ /skad cig nyid la rgyud du skye bar byed/ /dal ba'i rten 'diyid bzhin nor lhag pas// 'di 'dra rnyed pa da lta ma gtogs par/ /yang yang rnyed par dka' bas dal 'byor la/ /chos kyi sgo nas snying po len dgos

6so / / rten 'di yun ring mi gnas rab 'jig cing / /'chi ba nges med tshe 'dir stos shig ni/ /yang dag bsgrub la nges pa brtan po ni/ /rnyed na rab tu phan bde 'byung byed de/ /dam 〉〉sa nyams su ma blangs shi nas ni/ /tsha dmyal grang dmyal nyi tshe nye 'khor dang / /phyi sgrib nang sgrib zas skom sgrib pa dang //byings gnas kha 'chodar sdug bsngal la sku gas cadang / /de las khyodab pa'i skyabs ni su yod na/ /bla ma dbo na mchodag gsum la rag las pas/ /de la skyabs 'grojig bshags rab byedadathos//rgyu ni dge ba byas na 'bras bu ni/ /bde skyid thams cad rab tu 'byung bar byed/ /rgyu ni mi dge byas na 'bras bu ni/ /sdug bsngal mtha' dag rab tu myong bar byed/ /'khor ba'i bde bar ci tsam longs spyad kyang / /ngoms med mi 'dod sdug bsngal kun 'byung gzhi/ /mi rtag sdug bsngal nyes dmigs shes nas ni / / 'khor ba 'di las thar 'dod nges 'byung bskyed/ /thar 'dod sems des kun nas bslangs nas ni/ /bstan pa'i gzhi ma lha/ thar tshul khrims srungs/ /sems can rnams kyi sngasten du sangs rgyas kyi/ /bo/ 'phang thob na snyam pa'i sems bzang bya //de dag thams cad phan bde chen lnga dang / /ldan na bsam pa'i

7sems mchog bskyed dbo/sa sku / /phar phyin drug ni nyams su len pa dang / /de yi nang nas bsam gtan shes rab gnyis //chags sdang chu gas su mi 'thod zhi gnas dang / /de nyid la ni dpyad pa'i lhag malnga nga thor / /bshes gnyen bsten tshul nas bzung zhi lhag bar/ /thun mong lam la sbyangs nas stod rung du / / gyur pa'i tshe na gsang sngag sa theg pa la/ /bde blag nyid du myur bar 'jug byed shog /sngags la zhugs tshe mchog thun dasngo sa grub rnams/ /'grub gzhi dam tshig sgyu ma pa bsrung ba la/ /bathe sa min nges pa brtan sngo brnyod nas ni/ /sku/ga bsdu/sa bar du mig bzhin srung bar shog /de ltar lam rim rab tu bskrun pa'i mthus/ /cho gas gnyis mnga' thang legs par dar rgyas te/ /zhing 'di bde ba can gyi sar bkod nas//sems can dodan du sangs rgyas myur thodab shog ces pa 'di ni/mchog sprul rin po che dgung lo brgyad kyi dus su yon tan gzhir gyur ma'i tshig 'grel cung zad zhus skabs ku re'i tshul du lam rim zhig ce ma dathongs zhus par nyid nas dgyes bzhinadu lam rim mdor bsdus shig brtsams pa ma bcos par bris pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga waṃ/ /

8/byang 'dzab lam ༄snge patswarid sa khid skyong tshul mdor bsdus thar 'akod 'jugayogs tās bya ba bzhugs //༄༅༅/bstan pa'i bdag po thubadabang rdo rje 'changan/mipham 'jam dbyangs shing rta chen po zung //jo 'brom rgyal ba gnyis pa yab sras 11gas//brgyud pa gsum ldan bla ma'i mārgags la 'dud//thub gsung rab 'byams snying po 'dus pa'i bcud//ston mdzad dus gsum rgyal ba'i zhal skyin dngos//rje btsu na bla ma rnams la gsol 'debs na//bdagagazhan smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs//dus gsum rgyal kun bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam//skye dgu'i 'dod pa'i re stong dbang gi rgyal//che ba bzhi ldan byang chub lam rim gyi//darigs khrid rnying wagams su len tshul bri/'dir byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i khrid la sa bcad kyi dbang du byas na/chos khungs btsun par bstan pa'i phyir mdzad pa po'i che ba bshad pa/gdams ngag la gus pa bskyed pa'i phyir chos kyi che ba bshad pa/che ba gnyisadang ldan pa'i chos la nyan bshad ji ltar bya ba/gdams pa dngos kyis slob ma ji ltar bkri ba'i rim pa dang bzhi las/

9dang po la/ gdams pa 'di sher phyin gyi man ngagayin cing /thod 'dir thog mar lha/la 'byed byed kyi gzhung lam sgro na yin pas lam rim che chung du jo the'i rnam thar nyid gsungs la/ khrid kyi skabs su bstan pa'i bdag po nas maba'i bla ma'i bar gyi rnam thar rags bsdus re gsungs par mdzad pa bzhin/ dngos brgyud kyi bla ma thams cad lam rim gyi sgo nas rtogs pa gong mar gshegs tshul gyi rnam thar dran zhing rjes su slob ci thub byed pa ni mdzad pa wa'i che ba bshad pa'i dbe/sa pa yin cad/gnyis pa la/ che ba bzhi ni/ gdams ngag 'di la brten nas theg pa che chung dang mdo sngags kyi lung dang rtogs pa'i bstan pa sgras zin dang gnang bkag mi 'dra brnamasaganas skabs sku ṭaradon du 'gyur bas gang zag gcig 'tshang rgya ba'i cha rkyen du bo/ ba bstan pa thams cad 'gal med du rtogs pa'i che ba/ gsung rabadagongs 'grel dang bcas pa'i gzhung chen mo rnams ni phal cher so sku/ra rtog pa'i sher rab kyi dpyad sgom gtso bor ston la/ gdams pa 'dis de dag rnams kyi don dpyad 'jog ci rigs kyis nyams su len pa'i rim par dril nas ston pas nagasung rab thams cad nyams len lhaban pa'i gdams ngagatu 'char ba'i che ba/ bka' dang dgongs 'grel de dag thams cad kyi dgongs don la gdams ngag 'dis nges pa bde blag tu ster ba ni rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bde blag tu rnyed pa'i che ba/ de dag gi stobs kyis bka' la bzang ngan dang bshad chos sgrub chos 'gal bar 'dzin pa'i chos thong ginyes spyod chen po rang 'gags su 'gro ba'i che ba rnamasadang / mdo sngags gnyis ku'i gnad bsdus nas

10ston pas brjod bya yongs su rdzogs pa/ sems 'dul ba'i rim pa gtso bor ston pas lag tu blang bde ba/ shing rta chen po gnyis kyi lugs la mkhas pa'i bla ma gser gling pa dang / rig pa'i khu byug chung ba gnyis kyigadams pas brgyan pas lugasabazhan las khyad par 'phags gastolam sgron gyi khyad chos gsum gsungs pa rnams so/gsum pa ni/thog mar nyan bshad kyi skabs nas bzung ste gnad du 'grob gal che ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis gdams pa dngosagazhi'i nyonadu gsungs pa ste rgyas par lam rim che chung 11gas las shes par byacad/bzhi pa la/ lam gyi mab bshes gnyen bsten pa'i tshul dang / bsten nas blo ji ltar sbyang ba'i rim pa'o/ dang bo la gnyis/ nges pa bskyed pa'i phyir cung zad sprosate bshad pa dang / skyong tshul mdor bsdusate bstan pa'o/ dang po la/ slob dpon dang slob ma'i mtshan nyid dang / des de ji ltar bzhen pa'i tshul/ brten pa'i phanalon/ ma brten pa'i shesadamigs/de dag gi don bsdu ba rnams yod pa las bla slob kyi mtshan nyid sogs ni gzhung las shes par bya zhing / bsten tshul dngos ni dmigs khrid skyong ba'i skabs su mdor bsdus 'byung bas 'dir ma bkod do/ /gnyis pa skyong tshul mdor bsdus te bstan pa la/ skyong tshul la log rtog dgag pa sogs gzhung du blta zhing / lag len dngos la/thun gyi ngo bodang thun mtshams su ji ltar bya bganyes/ dang pol sbyor dngos mjug gsum las/ sbyor ba'i chos ni drug ste/ gnas khang byi dor bya zhing sku gsung thugs kyi rten bkram pa/ mchod pa g.yo med

11cing bkod pa mdzes par bshams pa/ stan bde ba la lus gnad dang ldan pas 'khod de/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rgyud dang 'dres nges su bya ba/ snurags zhing gsal gdab pa/ gsag sbyang gi gnad bsdus pa'i yan lag bdun pa maṇḍal dang bcas pa 'bul ba/ gasku la ba 'debs pa man ngag bzhen rgyud dang 'dres nges su bya ba'o/ dang po ni/ rang gzhan gyi rgyud kyi las ྅/na gyi sgrigapa rjodang ba sku gas kyi ched du dmigs pa'i sems bskyed kyis kun nas bslangs te/ bden bzhi'i nyams len dang ldan pas gnas khang byi dor bya zhing / ci 'byor pa'i gdan khri sogs kyi steng du bstan pa'i bdag po dang / khro bo/ rje bla ma/ rang gi maba'i bla ma sogs gsu per gyur pa'i dmigs rten gyi bris 'bur gyi sku rnams go rim ma 'chol bdang / sdud pa yan chad sher phyin gtso bor gyur pa'i gsung rten dang / thugs kyi rten mchod rten/ sa chi'am/ ༄ ༄la yan chad rnams legs par bkrams la/ bla ma'i ye shes chodas sku rten de dag gi rnam par shar bar mos/ gnyis pa ni/ rgyu'i g.yo dang kun slong gi g.yo gnyis dang bral ba'i mchod pa'i yo byad ci 'byor pa dang / khyad par du sdig sgrib 'dag cing byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gakhris kyis rgyud brlan pa sku/gas lam rim gyi rtogs pa skye ba'i rten 'brel du yon chab gatho rwanar bsngags pa dang / tshul khrims la bdug spros dang dri bzang / shes rab dang gtum mo dngad gsal sku gas kyi rten 'brel du mar me/ tshe ring ba la zhal zas sogs skabs su gang babs pa'i mchod rdzas gtsang zhing gya nom pa bkod pa mdzes shing dang ba 'dren pa bshams la grub ma thag yotsosnaḥ〉/ gsum

12brjod de byin gyis brlab pa'am/ mchod pa'i sprin gzungs dang bden stongs brtsod de byin gyis brlab/ gsum ba ni/ stan bde ba la lus rnam snang gi chodas bdun ldan sku gas spyod lam tshul mthun gyis 'khod de/ kun lhu/nga la legs par brtags nas tshe 'di'i snang shas sku gas kun lhu/nga ma dag pa mngon du gyur 'dug na/ blo ngan 'dis thog med nas da bar du sdug la sbyar zhing / da lta nyams len cung zad bgyid pa yang 'dis gnad du 'gror mi ster bar 'dug snyam du 'khon dran par byasate/ da ni 'di'i dbang du skad cig kyang mi gtong snyam pa'i 'phen pa drag po btang la/ sna bug nas rlung phyir bus te rnam rtog ngan pa de dag gis mtshon pa'i sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa cad nag lnga'i rnam par chodanate rang yal du 1/nga bar bsam/ rlung tshur rngub pa'i tshe rgyal ba sras bcas kyi byin rlabs 'od dkar wa'i rnam par snying gar thim par bsam/ rlung ro dgu phrags su bsal ba sogs man ngag ltar bya zhing / dal 'byor dang mi rtag pa'i ngang tshul bsam ste tshe 'di'i snang shas zil gyis mnan/ 'khor ba mtha' dag sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhenadu bsam stortsi ma'i snang shas bzlog ci thub dang / rang nyams la dpag ste mar gyur pa'i sems can ris su ma chad pa mtha'adag la byams rnying rje lhag bsam shugs drag wame kun nas bslang stodagosems khyad par can byang chub kyi sems bathos ma tshun chad gsal btab la/ de'i cingam yal ba'i ngang nas skyabs yul gsal gdab pa ni /rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar seṅge'i khri/ /rin chen las grub mtho zhing yangs pa'i dbus/ /slar yang seng khri padanyi zla ba'i

13steng / /maba'i bla ma bcom ldan thub pa'i dbang / /ga ser mdog mtshan dpe'i gzi brjid stong 'bar zhing / /chos gos gsum galhanal sa gcadan mnyam bzhag gis/ /bdud rtsis rab tu gang ba'i lhung bzed bsnams/ /'od phung dbus na rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs/ /thugs ka nas 'phros 'od zer rtsemo ru//rgya chen rjodad brgyud zab snu/ lta brgyud dang / /nyams len byin rlabs brgyud pa'i bla ma dang / /chos 'brel dngos thob bla ma ma lus dang / /rgyud sde bzhi 'brel yi dam dkyil 'khor lha//sangs rgyas byang sems rang rgyal nyan lnga sa dang / /dpa' lnga/ mkha' 'bo/ bstan srung snu gas kyis bskor/ /lha/ so'i mdun du 'gog lam rang bzhin gyi/ /gsung rab glegs bam rang sgra lha ga bzhin bzhugs/ /skyabs yul de rnams rang la dgyes tshul mdzad/ /rang gi mtha' sgor mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i tshogs/rang rang sdug bsngal myong bzhin 'khod pa dang / /lhan cig 'jigasadang drag was skyabs 'gro bya/ /bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /dngos brgyud bla ma rnams la skyabs sumachi//khyon pa sangs rgyas rnams la skyabs su mchi/ /skyob pa dam skrubs rnams la skyabs su mchi/ /'dren pa dge 'dun rnams la skyabs

14su mchi/ lan mngadu brtsod/ skyabs yul sku las cad dang bdud ci'i rgyun/ /dpag med babs pas jig sgrib kun sbyangasate/ /shlaugasung thugs kyi byin rlabs ma lus thob/ /dathon masnubagasum gyi skyabs 'og tshud par gyur/ /drin lan 'khor med mar gyur 'gro ba kun/ /phra rags 'khor ba'i mtsho las sgrol ba'i slad//bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob phyir du/ /zab rgyas lam bzang nyams su blang bar bya/ lanagasum sogs brtsod/ thub pa'i dbang wa'i sku las rang 'dra zhig /rang la thim pas rang nyid thub dbang skur/ /gyur pa'i sku las cad zer phyogs bcur 'phros//stod bcud kun sbyangs dag pa'i 'khor lor gyur/ /'gro kun phan tshun nye ring chags sdang dang / /bral ba'i btang sgoms la gnas bde dang ldan/ /sdug bsngal kun zhi zag med bde ba dang / /'bral ba med par smon zhing 'dun pa dang / /de ltar bdag gis bsgrub bya de ltar du/ /nus par bla ma lha yis byin gyis rākhas/ /khyad par mkha' mnyam sems can kun snga na du//myur ba myur bar rtsodags pa'i sangs rgyas kyi/ /lo/ 'phang bdag gis cis kyang thob phyir du/ /byang chub lam gyi rim pa bsgom par bgyi/ lan gsum/ skyabs yul mtha' dag thub pa'i dbang

15por bsdus/ /de yang rang gi smin mtshams thim par gyur/bzhi pa ni/ slar yang sngar bzhin seng khri pad zla'i steng / /bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i mtha' skor du/ /dngos brgyud bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas dang / /theg gsum 'phags snunags mkha' 'bo/ srung mar bcas/ /dpag yas sprul pa'i b.lo/da pa khyod bzhin bzhugs/ /gatherga 'khe/ra kun gyi gnas lngar yi ges mtshan/ /hūṃ gi 'od kyis ye shes spyan drangs thim/ /re re'ang skyabs gnas kun 'dus ca rwaper gyur/ lasadang po bas sdig sgrib dang mdag pa'i snang cha rjodang phyir khrus gasku/la gal che bas/ khrus kyi khang ba zhes sku/gas kyis khrus khang gsal gdab/ji ltar bltams pa sku gas tshigs bcad mang nyung ci rigs pa brjod de khrus gsol/ de dag sku la sogs kyis sgyudabyi/stong gsum kunatumo/ /srab 'jam yang ba rki/ /rgyal ba mtshan dpe'i rnams kyis dri bzang dang shos rgyan phul/ bdag dang 'boste la sogs brtsod de rang rang gi gdan khri la bzhugs shing khrus khang mi dmigs par bsam/ lnga pa ni/ rgyas par na lam rim brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs phyag 'tshal du bsgyur nas brjod cing phyag 'tshal/ bsdu na 1 sangs rgyas thams cad sogasadang / rgya chen ྅7da pa'i brgyud la phyag 'tshal lo1/ zhes sogs dang / rab 'byams gsung rab

16kun zhes sogs brjod/ de gnyis gang byed kyang de rjes/ ji snyed su dag ces sku gsanas balhag/ zhes pa'i bar dmigs pa rnams yid 'khul nges byasate bcad/ maṇḍal so bdun ma sogs rgyas bsdus ci rigs 'bul/grub na tshom bu bdun ma grangs gsog ste ci mang phul kyang legs/ drug pa ni/ dpal ldan rtsaba'i bla ma rin khrod che/ zhes sogs kyi tshig rkang tha ma lan gnyis brjod pa'i dang wa'i tshe/ thub dbang gi mdun gyi maba'i bla ma las rang 'dra gnyis pa zhig byon te rang gi spyi bor seng khri pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs te bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab pa'i ro/na du ngo chen zhu 'bul mdzad cing / gnyis pa'i tshe spyi wa'i bla ma las rang 'dra gnyis pa zhig chad de rang la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par bsam/de nas rgyas pas na/ 'dren pa mnyam med so/gas/ lam mchodag sgo 'byed ltar rang gis lam khrid thob pa'i brgyud pa ltar rtsaba'i bla ma la thug gi bar gyi gsol 'debs dal bus brjod/ bsdu na/ phun mārgags dge legs bye bas bskrun pa'i sku/ /mtha' yas 'awa/ ba'i re ba 'e/nga ba'i gsung / /ma lus shes bya ji bzhin gzigs pa'i thugs//shākya'i ga la ga11la ba 'debs/ /byams pa 11gas med dbyig gnyen rnam grol sde/ /mchog sde dul ba'i sde dang grags pa'i dpal/ /seng bzang ku sa li gnyis gser gling pa/ /rgya chen khyodad pa'i brgyud la gasku la ba 'debs/ /'jam dbyangs

17yod med phyogs 'jig klu sgrub dang / /zla ba grags pa rig pa'i khu byug che/ /sangs rgyas dbokhengs lha/nga 'phags pa yab sras sogs/ /zab snu/ lta ba'i brgyud la galha/la ba 'debs/ /thugs rje chen po bde gshegs rdo rje 'chang / /mchog zung ti lo pa dang nā ro pa/ /dpal mchog khom lha ba dngas ti sha /nyams len byin rlabs brgyud la gasku/la ba 'debs/ /bshad sgrub gdams pa'i masnu ga mnga'a.a ti sha /bka' gdams bstan pa'i mes po 'brom ston rje/ /rnal 'byor rnam bzhi sku mched gsum la 5ges/ /bka' gams bla ma rnams la gaskule ba 'debs/ /rgyal ba kun da1༄sa rje btsun the nga kha pa/ /rgyal tshab dam pa mkhas grub dge legs dpal/ /'jam dpal rgya mtsho shes rab seṅge sogs/ /brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams lagasku/la ba 'debs/ /skyabs gsum kun 'dus bla mamo/ /drin can bla ma rnams la galha/la ba 'debs/ zhes pa rnams kyi tshig rkang tha ma lan gnyis re brtsod pas/dang po'i tshe bla ma de dag gi sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas zab rgyas kyi rtogs pa skye ba'i gegs byed sbyangs/ gnyis pa'i tshe rang 'dra gnyis pa chad de thim pas dogs pa myur du skye bar byin gyis brlabs par bsam/de nas yon tan gzhir gyur ma yang tshig rkang tha ma lan gnyis re bdud mi'abebs sbyang gi dmigs pa dang bcas brjod/ de tsam gyi long med

8na gong gi bla ma'i gsol 'debs rnams kyi 'phror/bshes gnyen la ma gus pa nas bzung zhes sogasadon chen pogasum gyi gsol 'debs lan gsushāsbyis drag tu //bye nas/tshogasakyizhi(rnams rim bzhin ga ra thilha'i// 'chang dbang thub pa thugs yir thim//de yang spyi maba'i bla ma la/ /thim pas bla ma thub dbang rdo rdo /chang//semasdu //'a gsum gyi lhag nyid sna rmye gyur//gsuXsdu/sa pa sa phyag 'tshal ṅgi /༵/ chogs sna 'aspyu da ltung ma yurnyi bshags//dal/nga sa 'ar bar bar bskul//da mthar bzhugs gal dgotshogs byang rnyo bathos mas maṇḍal tso/skyabazhi'i bdag nyid cu sogs sno masagasol slo rgyas tshom/bsnarnyi/skyabs gan// /na'ajesabla ma lhag pa lha//thub dbang 'chang la ga ba 'bas/zhes pa lanagasum bdun sogs tsi'agrub brtsod/thun de la bshesaganyen barsā tshul gyidamigs skoragatsobor skyongagayin na / bshes gnyen bsten pa'i phan yon dang ma bsten pa'i nyes dmigs rnams bsam ste/de dang mthun pa'i gsol 'debs bde lam nas ཿnga bltar bya la/thunabakhigalasam ngas rdzogs kritamigs rimasathar chasna su skyoX bayin na/bawagadangam sems na/ thams cad 'ar bar skyas nas yun nga la shugs drag pa sdug bsngal

19kṣiṃtshogs pa zhig myong ba 'di/ byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i rtogs pa tshul bzhin du ma skyes pas lan par 'dug pas/ da bdag dang ma sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i shogs pa mtha'adag tshul bzhin du bskyedagus par bla ma lhas byin gyi sa brlab tu galha/la/ de ltar galha/la ba btab pas salus las/ /'od dang bdud rtsisna lnga'i rgyun babs pas/ /bdag sku/gas 'bo/ kun nyes pa'i snu gas sbyangs te/ /stodags pa khyad 'phags rgyud la skyes par gyur/ces brjod cing bsam/ sbyor chos kyi rim pa'adi rnamasacig rgyas bsdus ji ltar yang donayid la 'char nges byas te gnad du 'gro ba zhig dgos kyi/ 'di dag khral chos lta bu'i tshab tshubatu btang nas dngos gzhi'i dmigs rnam skyong ba skad byed pa ni rlan dang sa la sogs pa gangayang med par rdogasebatu sa bon btab padang 'dra b.ragasungs pas nges par lam gyi rtogs pa zhig skye bar 'dod na 'di dag la 'bad pa gal chelha(/lha gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i dmigs rnam skyong tshul la/ thog maradarigs pa'i grangs dang sgo rim rnams nges par byasatededang mthun par dran shesadang ldan pas dpyad sgom 'jog sgom skabs su gang babs pa'i sgonas skyong dgos shing 'diradarigs sgor rnams la shar sgom bya tshul tshig ris mdor bsdus tsam 'god pa la/

20bsam bas bsten tshul dang spyor bas bsten tshul 'o/ dang po la gnyis/ mab dad pa sbyangs pa dang / bka' drin rjes su dran tegus par bya ba'o/ dang bo ni/ spyi wa'i bla ma lha'i thugs ka nas chos 'brel dngos thob kyi bla ma tshigs bcad gcig tsam nyan pa yan chad gcig kyang ma lus par spros te mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par mos nas 'di ltar/bdag gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'di rnams sangs rgyas dngos yin te/ rgyal ba rdo je 'chang gis snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i dus su tha mal ba'i dge ba'ibashes gnyen gyi skye'o rnam par bstananas bdag cag sangs rgyasadangos gyamathong ba'i skalab med pa rnams rjes su 'dzin par zhal gyis bzhes pa bzhin du/ sku'i rnam pa rang cag rnams dang skal ba mnyam pa'i tha mal ba'i rnam par bstan pa ma gartagasadangos lnga'i gnas chod la skyon kun zad yon tan kun ldan gyisangadag par thegs pa'i sangasargyasadangosayin par the tshom med/ da lta rang cag rnams la sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad pa la skyon gyi rnam par snang ba 'di rnams kyang don dngos gnas la skyon de yod nas snang ba ma yin gyi/ rang gi snang ba ma dag pa'i dbang gis yin te/ blo bur gyi 'khrul rgyu'i dbang gis dung dkar ser bo dang / gangs ri sngon por snang ba sogs 'byung na/ thog ma med pa nas nyon mongs pa'i nad

21kyis btab pa la ma dag pa'i 'khrul snang ci'i phyir mi'achar sa gsum bzhes pa 'phags pa lnga gas med kyis rje btsun byams pa khyi mor gzigs padang / nā ro pas te lo pa nya gson sreg byed par gzigs pa sogs dam pa de dag la yang snang tshul de lta bu byung na/ bdag cag las ྅rten gyi sgrib gasku/gas ches 'thug 1/sa bsgribs pa'i chod la dpag na bla ma midang dge lhung gi rnam par snang nas chos nyan rgyu byung ba yang shin tu car mtshar che/de bzhin gshegs pas bdud dang gcade sbyin dud 'a sa su sprul nas sems can gyi don mdzad par mdo las gsung na/ sangs rgyas dngos sumathong ba'i skal ba med pa bdag cag la skal ba mnyam pa'i skye'o rnam pa 'di lta bu ched du gnyer nas bstan payin par 'dug da lta rang re'i snang tshod la yang tshul khrims dang ldan pa / mang du 11sa pa/ gzhan phan gyi bsam pa 11gas myongan tan 'di dang 'di lta bu yod par 'dug snyamadu yon tan gyi ngos nas bsam zhing skyon gyi charas nas lha ga pa rnam pa thams cad du dgag ci thub la 'bad/ bag med pa dang jo na snu/ngas mang ba sku/gas kyi dbang gis skyon rtog byung na yang bshags bsdam la 'bad par bya/ mdor na bdag gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'di rnams

22kyi sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad pa thams cad sangs rgyas dngos kyi mdzad par mthong ba'i dad pa bcos ma ma yin pa bde blag tu skye bar bla ma lhas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes brjod la bdud mi'abebs sbyang gidamigs pa byed dgos para'og ma rnams lasang shes par bya/ gnyis pa ni/ bdag gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'di rnams ni yon tan gyi cadas nas sangs rgyas thams cad dang spangs rtogs mtho dman med par mnyam na yang / bka' drin gyi ngos nas phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad las kyang lhag tshespyir milus thob nas zas khamagacig la longs rjod payan chad kyi rgyu tshul khrims dang / sbyin pa sku/gas la slob tshul dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis bstan pa la brtenanas shes pa yin pas/ tshul de lta bus mtshon nas 'di phyi'i legs chogs mtha' dag bla ma'i bka' drin la brten nas 'byung zhing / khyad par du da lta'i gnas skabs lta bu la mtshon na gang la gang 'dul gyi sku'i rnam pa so sku/ra bstan nas dam pa'i chodas la gzhug par mdzad pa yin te/thog mar klog gi slob dpon du sprul te yi ge bslabs / mkhan rākha tu sprul nas rab tu byung zhing jom pa stsalate bstan pa'i sgor btsud/ rdo je slob dpon du sprul nas dbang bskur/ bshes

23gnyen dam bdu mar sprul nas mdo sngags kyi zab khrid man ngag lung sogs gang 'dod du stsal/ mdor na yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis lhu/ba pa'i dus su snumis tshigs bcad re'i phyir du sku lus la mar me stong btsugs pa/ lcags gzer stong btab pa sogs dam pa bo/nga ma rnams kyis chos kyi phyir du dka' spyad dpag med mdzad kyang / bdag cag gis de lta bu'idaka' spyad gang yang ma dathodas par rang gi cadas nas sgrub par nus na tshe thung gcig la sangs rgyas kyi sar the snu ma med par baspo da par nus pa'i mdo sngags yongs rdzogs kyi gdams pa pha nor bu la 'thodags pa bzhin du dgyes bzhin du stsal ba'i bka' drin ni / ming tshig yi ge ji snyed cig gis chos bstan pa de snyed kyi bskal par lus lha/ga so/ngas spyodad thams cad kyis masnu da kyang cha shas tsam yang gzhal bar ga la nus/ de lta bu'i bka' drin chen wa darngos su dran pa'i gus pa bde blag tu skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ gnyis pa ni/ de ltar sangs rgyas dngos kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen bka' drin 'kherdzor mtha' med pa 'di rnams kyi ba spu'i khung bu gcig kyang phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad las lhag pa'i bsod nams kyi zhing du bsngags pas na/ zang

24zingagidangos pogangayodaphangs pa med par 'bul bdang / lus sku/ga yal bar tho/rate bsnyen bkur zhabs tog ci nus su bsgrub pa dang / khyad par du khas blangs pa'i bslab khrims rnam par dag pa gzhir bzung ste rgyal ba'i bstan pa la ༄dzis bsam lhu/ma gsum gyi sbru/ nas ci gsung bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i macesad pas mnyes par byed nus par byin gyis brlab tu galha/la/ thun gcig la dmigs skor re re tsam las mi skyong na/ thun gyi mjug tu ji ltar bya ba'i rim pa 'og nas 'byung ba ltar nyams su blang ngo /gnyis pa bstenanas blo ji ltar spyong ba'i rigab laganyis/ dal ba'i rten la snying po blang ba'i phyir bskul ba dang /snying spro ji ltar len pa'i tshul lo/ dang bo la gsum/ dal 'byor ngos bzung ba/don che bar bsam pa/ rnyed dka' bar bsam pa'o/ dang po ni/ spyi bor bla ma lha sgom bzhin pa'i ngang nas skabs su gang babs pa'i dmigs 〈snar rnams skyong dgos pa 'og ma thams cad la 'dra bar shes par bya'o/ bdag cag rnams cadag ma med pa nas las nyon gyi gzhan dbangadu song bas/ phal cher ngan sku/nga gsum lha/gas mi |/ma pa'i gnas su 'khyams pa las da lta bla ma dalo na mchodag gi thugs rje'i mthu las/ ngan song gsum dang / lha tshe ring po ste mi ma yin pa'i mi khom pa bzhi dang / yul mtha' 'khob pa dang / rgyal ba'i

25bka' med pa dang / log lta can dang / glen lkugs sogs mi'i mi kho ma pa bzhi ste/ mi kho ma pa brgyad dang bral ba'i dal ba 'di ltar lnga ba/ mthun cadags nas/ mir skyes pa/ chodas tshigs kyi yul dbus su skyes pa/ dbang 11 tshang ba mtshams med ma byas pa/ sdokhyod gsum la dad pa storang 'byor lnga dang /sangs rgyas khyonye cing / des cesas gsung ba/ bstan pa gnas pa / de la 'jug tu yod pa/ chos kyi mthun rkyen 'byor pa ste gzhan 'byor lnga yang tshang / mdor na chos bsgrub pa'i 'gal rkyenadang bral zhing mthun rkyen tshang ba'i skabs 'dir chos shig ma sgrub par slar yang mi kho ma pa'i gnas de dag tu phyir 'o/ga nas 'gro na sems med par gyur pa lta bu yin pas rten 'di'i steng nas gtan gyi 'dun ma'i cangab tshugs pa zhig ci nas kyang bya'o/de ltar byed nus par bla ma lhas byin gyis brlabatu gsol/gnyisaponi/de lta bu'i dal 'byor gyi rten thob pa 'di shin tudon che gle gnas skabs kyi dbang du byas na macan mtho'i lus rten khyad par can gyi rgyu/ sbyin pa/ tshul khrims/ bakhrod pa sku/gas rten 'dis bde blag tu sgrub nus shing / mthar thug thar lam bsgrub pa'i rten la 'dzam bu gling pa'i mi maspyodag tu bsngags par

26ma zad/ theg pa chen snga'i lam gyi gzhung shing byang chub kyi sems rin wa ཿ mi'i rten la gsar du skye ba 'dra ba'i dongs dang ldan pa rten gzhan la mi'abyung bar gsungs/ sngags bla med kyi lam la brten nas snyigs dus kyi tshe thung gcig la 'tshang rgya ba la yang 'dzum bu'i gling pa'i mi mngal skyes khams drug ldan gyi rten mchog tu bsngags pas/ bde ba can gyi byang sems rnams kyang rten 'di la smon gnas su byed par gsungs/ de ltar gnas skabs dang / mthar thug la ltos nas don che ba'i rten de lta bu thob nas de nyid kyi rgyu la ma 'bad na rin phring nas lag stong du sdog pa lta bu yin pas rten 'di don med du mi btang bar snying po zhig nges par blang bar bya'o/ de ltar byed nus par bla ma lhas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ gsum ba ni/de ltar rten 'di don che bar ma zad rnyed kyang shin tu dka' ste/ ngan 'gro dang bde 'gro nas shi 'phos te/ ngan 'gror 'gro ba ni sa chen wa'i rdul dang / de gnyis nas bde 'gror skye bani don pa'i phyag sen gyi rtsemos bzhes pa'i rdul dang 'dra bar lung las gsung la / de'i rgyu mtshan yang skye cha/ phal cher mi dge ba stobs chen gsag pa la ches cher brtson pa'i rdobs kyis yin zhing / spyir

27bde 'gro tsam thob pa la'ang tshul khrims dang 'brel ba'i dge ba rnam dag sna gcig byed dgos pa dang / khyad par du dal 'byor tshang ba lnga ba pa la tshul khrims rnam par dag pas gzhi bzung /sbyin sku gas kyi lha gas byas/ 'di snang gi zhen pas ma bslad pa'i sgyu/na lam gyis mtshams sbyar ba sku/gas dbo/sa na/ rgyu de lta bu cha tshang sgrub mkhan shin tu dasna na zhing / rang rgyud la brtag na phyi mar phan pa'i dge ba rnam dag sdud bde nges pa snagacig kyang sems la 'dzin rgyu med/ jig ltung bsags pa grangs kyis mi lang zhing / bshags bsdam lha/gas tshig tsam du 'bo ba 'di la dpag na phyi mar bde 'bo/ tsam chodab pa yang shin tu dka' bar 'dug na dal 'acadar tshang ba'i rten rnam par dag pa chodab tu re bzhi sku/sa ka sran ma btab nas don ka nas bsduchis byed pa dang 'dra bar snang / des na gtan gyi bde sdug gi 'dam ka rang lag na sku da pa'i skabs 'dir lhu/ gsum dge ba la ci nus su 'bad pa'i sgo nas rten bzang 'di la snying sngo len nus par bla ma lhas byin gyis brlab tu ga11la/lha gnyis pa la gsum/ skyes gachung ngu dang thun mong pore lam rim la blo sbyang ba/ 'bring dang thun mong ba'i lam rim la blo sbyang ba/ skyes

28bu chen wa'i lam gyi rim pa la blo sbyang ba'o/ dang po la gnyis/ 'jig rten phyi ma don gnyer gyi blo bskyed pa dang / 'jig rten phyi mar bde ba'i thabs bsten pa'o/ dang sgyu la gnyis/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsam pa ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal bsam pa'o/ dang bo ni/rnyed par dka' zhing don che ba'i dal 'byor gyi rten 'di yang yun ring du mi gnas par nges par 'jig sme jon khyon pa'i rgyal ba sras bcas paṇa grub skyes chen dam pa grangs med pa rnams kyang mya ngan las 'das/rang gi mkhan slob mdza' bshes nye 'brel ji snyed cig 'jig rten pha rol tu song zin cing / da lta gson pa 'di dag thams cad kyang ring por mi thogs par 'jig rten pha rolatu 'gro bar nges/ 'chi bdag gi chad pa de nam lnga ga tu babs pa'i tshe/ go sa mtho dman dang / lus bzang ngan dang / yul gangadu bsdad kyang khyad par med par 'joms shing / de yang mgyogs pas 'bros pa dang / stobs dang nor dang rdzas sngags smanadang rim gro sku gas gang gis kyang bsdudag tu med/ tshe tshad 'o/ brgya thub pa ni srid mthar snang la/ de thub tu chug kyang de'i bar gyi lo ni zla ba dang / zla ba yang zhag dang / de yang nyin mtshan snga ro bye ro le'ugs lha/nga bas 'dzad pas na/ gsad bya'i lug sogs

29gshed ma'i drung du gom pa re res nyer 'gro ba ltar tshe mi 'dzad pa'i skabs cung zad kyang med par 'jig rten pha rol tu mngon du phyogs te rgyug bzhin pa yin zhing / ltag chu chad pa'i rdzing bu bzhin du tshe lhag la ston pa cung zad kyang med/ gzhon dus lobacu 'e/ra tsam la chos mi dran zhing / rgas dus cesas sgrub pa'i mthu med/de'i bar gyi dus su yangaganyid kyis phyed 'dang zhing /rnam g.yeng bza' btung ngag 'khyal sogs kyis kyang dus du ma zhig zad nas snu sa byed long cung zad las med par nges par 'chi/ des na sma lam gyi dga' ston lta bu'i tshe 'di'i bslu brid la ma chags par chos nges par byed dalo/sa par thag gcad par bya'o/de ltar byed nus par bla ma lhas byin gyis brlabatugasol/de ltar nges par 'chi bar ma zad nam 'chi la yang nges pa med de / spyir na 'dzam bu gling pa'i tshe la nges pa med cing da lta'ang rgan gzhon bar ma'i go rim med par 11 bur du phyi nang gi 'chi rkyen gyis shi ba macaran sum du mchodang zhing lnga/sa pa 'di ltar yin/tshe srog rlung dmar nang gi mar me bzhin du nang gi 'byung ba 'khrugs pa'i nad dang / phyi'i mi dang mi ma yin pa'i gcadad byed dang / 'byung wa'i gcadad pa sku/gas 'chi rkyen shin tu mang zhing /

30der ma zad kha zas ma 'a'od pa/ mdza' tho/sa bslus pa/ gnas khang rdib pa sku gas/ gasku na rkyen rnams kyang 'chi rkyen du 'gyur ba shin tu mang / lus srog chu'i lbu ba ltar shin tu nyam chung bas/nad dang gnod pa phra more la snyad 'dogs byas nas kyang 'jig nus par the cho ma med/ des na 'chi bdag gis lus sku/ga nam 'joms nges pa med pas/ de ring lta bu la yang 'chi mi 'chi gang du yang thag mi chod pas na da lta nyid nas chos bya bar thag gcad par bya'o/ de ltar byed nus par bla ma lhas byin gyis brlab tugasol/de ltar 'jig rten pha rol tu 'gro ba'i tshe gnyen bshes 'khor g.yog brtsegadung che ba ci tsam gyis mtha' bskor te gnas kyang phan tshun sems 'phreng ba tsam las gcig kyang 'khrid du med/ zas nor longs spyod lha'i dpal 'byor la 'gran pa sku/da kyang sbrang ma'i sbrang cingabazhin du gzhan gyis babo/ bsha' byed pa las rdul phran tsam yang rang gis 'khyer du med/ tha na ma'i mngal nas lhan cig skyes pa'i lus 'disang bzhag nas 'gro dgos na gzhan lta ci smos/ de'i tshe rjes su 'brang ba ni dkar nag gi las 'bras kho na yin pas/ snying 1 23da pa'i tshe 'di'i bya bzhag la mabo ma 'khor bar phyi mar phan pa'i chodas kho

31na bya bar thag gcad par byacad/ de ltar byed nus par bla ma lhas byin gyis brlab tu gasku la/ gnyis pa ni/ de ltar shi ba'i 'og tu med de mi 'gro bar bde 'gro dang ngan 'gro gang rung du skye ba len dgos shing / de dag gang du skye la rang dbang med par las kyi rjes su 'brang dbo/sa pas/ lhu/ma gsum gyi bcas 'gal sogs bcas pa dang rang bzhin gyi jig pa cisadage ba rgyal wa'i gan mdzod bzhin du da lta bsags 'dug cing / thog med nas bsags pa 'bras bu ma phyung bayang rang rgyud ladapag med yod pas/ de dag bshags bsdam lha/bas chen gyis rjodang bar ma nus na 'bras bu ngan song du skye ba las 'os med/ der skyes na tsha dmyal du cardog thams cad lcags bsregs kyi sagazhi/|/ra yug thams cad lcags bsregs kyi rwa bas bskor zhing / steng 'og phyogs mtshams kunatu me lce tsha zhing 'bar ba 'khrugs pa'i nang du sems can der skyes pa rnams kyis mtshog cha kṣiṃmārgags kyis phan tshun brdeg cing brgyal nas yang lha/sa te 'thab padang /lus la thigatag sngo/ btabakas sog lesagashag padangaka lcags kyi ri chen wa'i bar du 'tshir ba dang / lcags khang me 'bar ba sgo red pa'i nang du bsreg pa dang / lcags zangs dpag tshad

32du ma yod pa'i nang du nya bzhin bsreg cing khro chu khol ma'i nang du 'tshod pa/ lcags kyi gsal shing 'bar ba la bskyon pa/ lus me dang da byer med du bsreg pa sogs kyi sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa myong zhing / tshe tshad kyang 'dod lha rigs drug gi tshe tshad rnams tsha dmyal dang po drug gi zhag rer rim bzhin brtsib sogs kyis rang lo lnga brgya nas khri drug stong gi bar thub cing /rab tu tsha ba pas bar bskal phyed dang / mnar med pas bar bskal gcig thub par gsung la/ des na tsha dmyal gyi tshe thung shosayang sos pa'i zhagagacig la milo'abum phrag dgubacuyod pas da ltar gyi nyams la dpag ste 'jigs shing skrag pa'i blo ci skye bya/ grangadamyal gyiganagasaskyesanagangs ri'i rubasabalhan ba'i 'khyag pa'i sbubs gyakha ba bu yug 'tshub pa'i rlungagis bta ba pas chu bur byung zhing /rdol ba dang / nyam thag pa'i skad 'byin zhing / pags pa'i mdog nyon po dang dmar wa yenags su gyur te maḥ cen wa'i chab rom gas pa ltar thag sgra dang bcasate sha rus tshal ba mang por gas pa sogs kyi sdug bsngal myong zhing /tshe tshad kyang khal brgyad cu shong ba'i til gyi bang ba nas myo brgya brgya na til re re phyung bas ma lus par zad pa tshe thung shos su

33gsung / gzhan yang tsha dmyal gyi nye 'kho ra du me ma mur gyi 'obs dang / phyi sa'i 'dam dang / spu gri'i so gtam pa'i lam dang / nags tshal ral gri'i 'o/ ma can dang / shal ma li'i tshal dang / chu klung rab med rnams dang / nyi tshe ba'i dmyal ba sku gas su yang rang rang gi las kyi nus pa ma zad kyi bar du sdug bsngalamyong bar 'gyur/ dud 'gror skyes na phan tshunagacig gis gcig gasku da cing za ba dang / gzhan gyi sku byad du gyur pas bkol spyod dang / brdung brdeg dang / gsod pa sogs kyi sdug bsngal bskal pa'i bar du myong ba yang yod par bshad/yi dwags su skyes na/ lus rjodang dum tshig pa lta bu bkres sa/ma gyis gdung bas kha shin tu skam zhing / lces ldag pa/ chu mig sku/gas su rgyu ba na sems can mamārgan cha sna mārgags 1/gas pas phyir 'gog pa dang / chu klung rnag khrag tu mthong ba dang / kha khab mig tsam dang / mgrin pa rta rnga ltar phra la lto ba ri ltar che bas/ bza' btung mi nus shing the/ ba mi khengs la/ khengs kyang yan lag rtoltar phra bas mi theg pa dang / gzhan yang zas skom la me 'bar ba dang / bshang gcir 'gyur ba sku gas kyi sdug bsngal lo lnga stong dang khri la sogs pa'i bar du myong bar

34gsung / da lta tsha grang gi sdug bsngal phra mo dang / zhag gcig gi bkres sgom tsam yang mi bakhrodata sdug bsngal delta bu ji ltar bakhrod paranus snyam du 'jigs shing skrag pa'i tsā ci skye bya zhing /da lta ngan song du gnas pa'i sems can de dag dang rang re rnamasanyes pa mnyamadu byas pa'i rkun thogs lta buyin pas cig ltung rnams 'dag nges kyi bshags bsdam drag po dang / sdig sgong dge sgrub la rtsegacig tu 'bad pa'i sgo nas ngan 'gro'i skye sgo cis kyang khegs par bya/ de ltar byed nus par bla ma lhas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/bsterton phyizangar2 dogacu'iwab khabasten bstan pa la 'jug pa'i sgo dam pa skyabs 'gro sbyang ba/ bde legs thams cad kyi mab las 'bras la yid ches kyi dad pa bskyed pa'o/ dang bo /de ltar shi ba'i 'og tu ngan song mu mtha' med par 'khyam dgos par mthong ba na/ 'jigs pa de las skyob pa'i skyabs da lta nas btsal dgos te/ ngan 'gror skyes pa na skyabs btsal yang mi rnyed cing / blang dor gyi gnas la 'jug pa'i sdu'i mthu yang med par gsung / des na 'jigs pa de rang thog tu ma babs gong du dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro dgos shing / de la

35yang rang nyid ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal la 'jigs shing skrag pa dang / mchog gsum de la las skyob pa'i nus pa yod par yid ches pa gnyis skabs 'dir skyabs 'gro'i rgyu yin la/ de gnyis cig tsam du song na skyabs 'gro yang de dang 'dra ba zhig las mi 'ong bas/ rgyu de gnyis shugs drag la brtan cing yid 'khul nus pa zhig bskyed dbo/sa/ skyabs su 'bo/ ba'i yul la/ tshangs pa dang / dbang phyug sogs 'jig rten pa'i lha mthu khro che rnams rang 'dam du bying bas gzhan 'dam du bying ba 'don mi nus pa ltar/ rang nyid 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa las ma grol bas gzhan gyi skyabs byed mi nus/ sangs rgyas ba〉〉ma ldan 'a das ni / rang 'jigs pa thams cad las bo la zhing / gzhan 'jigs pa las 1stol ba'i thabs la mkhas/ kun la thugs rje chen khro nye ring med par 'jug phan btags ma btags thams cad kyi don mdzad pas na gtan gyi skyabs su ྅rdos la/ de'i phyir na de sa bstan pa'i chos dang / de'i rjes su slob pa'i dge 'dun yang skyabs su ྅sdos/ de'i phyir phyi'i yan lag skyabs kyi sku na tan ma tshang ba med kyang / nang gi yan lag stanabakal nas skyabs su ma song na skyob tshul med pas/ khyad par bzhi ngang ldan pa'i

36sbru/ nas skyabs su 'bo dbo sa/ de yang sangs rgyas kyi sku'i sku na tan mtshan dpe gsal swā gas kyis spras pa/ gsung gispenan tan yan lag drug cu'i dbyangs dang ldan zhingagasung dbyangasagacig nyid 'gro ba rang rang gi skad du go nas dri ba kun gyi lan mdzad pa / thugs kyi skudan tan shes bya thams cad la mkhyen pa 11gas pa med cing snying rje chen wa sa rang dbang med par bcings pa/'phrin las dus las sku la ba med par 'bad med lhun grub tu 'jug pa sogs dang / yon tan de dag gang las 'byung ba'i chodas dang / de tshul bzhin du sgrub pa'i dge 'dun gyi sku na tan yang tshul de'i sgo nas shes par bya/ dkon mchog gsum nang phan tshun gyi khyad par/ mtshan nyid dang / 'phrin las dang /snu sa pa dang / sgrub pa dang / rjes su dran pa dang / balha/da nams 'phel ba las gyur pa'i khyad snu sa rnams shes par bya zhing / de ltar sku na tan dang khyad par shes pa tsam min par/sangs rgyas skyabs lha na pa dang / chodas skyabs dacadas dang dge 'dun skyabs bsgrub pa'i bo gas su bzung ba'i sgo nas khas len pa dang / de yang skyabs la gnyis 'dzin byed pa ma yin par phyi nang gi ston pa dang / bstan pa dang / de la slob pa gsum

37gyi mchoge dman shes nas dalo/na macesag gsum |da na la skyabs su 'dzin pa'i gzhan du mi smra ba ste khyad par bzhi dang ldan pa'i sgo nas/ bdag dang sems can thams cad 'khor ba dang ngan song gi 'jigs pa las da lta nyid du bskyabatu gsol/ skyid sdug legs shes ji ltar gyur kyang khyed mkhyen snyam du rnying thag pa na sa blo bkal te skyabs su 'gro bar bya'o/ skabs 'dir/ bla ma yi dam dathon mchogagasum la skyabs su mchi'o/zhes gang mang brtsod cing / bla ma lha'i thugs ka nas skyabs yul nam mkha' gang ba sprosate bzhugs par bsam la bdud mi'abebs sbyang gi dmigs pa yang bya/༈de ltar skyabs su lha/nga nas rgyal 1/ la skyabs btsal nade'i khrims laganasadagos pa bzhinadu skyabasagasum bslab bya la/ 'jig rten pa'i lha gzhan la skyabs su mi 'gro bdang / sems can laganod 'tshe thong ba dang / dashon mchog gsum la yid mi ches shing skur ba 'debs pa rnams la mthun 'grogs mi byed pa stodagag pa'i bslab bya gsum dang / sangs rgyas kyi stugazugs bca da'agasashes ci 'dra lasang 'phyab sogs mi gus pa spangs te ston pa ltar bkur ba'i zhing du 'dzin pa/chos tshig bzhi ba zhig yan chad la ma gus pa spang zhing glegs

38bam sa sgre bor 'jig padang 'gomaXg sogs mibyed par chos dkon mchog ltar gus par bya/ ngur smrig gi rtags tsam 'dzin pa yan chad la mi brnyas paradage 'dun dkon mchog ltar gus par bya ba 〉sgrub pa'i bslab bya gsumadang / thun mong gi bslab bya la dkon mchog gsum gyi khyad par dang yon tan dran pas yang dang yang du skyabs su 'gro ba/ dus rtag tu mchod pa la brtson zhing ci za ci 'thung gi phud dbul ba/ 'gro ba gzhan yang skyabs 'gro la 'god pa/ bya ba dngadagos pa ciyod kyang dathon mchog la brten pa las 'jig rten pa'i thabs gzhan sgong ba/phan skuzhe shesanas nyin lanagasum mtshan lan gsum du skyabs su 'gro ba/ srog gi phyir yang dgon mchog mi gtong bar dam bca' zhing / bzhad gad tsam gyi phyir du yang skyabs gtong ba'i tshig mi smra ba ste drug la bslab/ skyabs 'gro tshig tsam min pa rgyud la mod na nang pa sangs rgyas par tshud pa/ rjom pa thams cad kyi rten du 'gyur ba/ sdig sgrib 'dag pa/ bsod nams rgya chen po gsog pa/ ngan 'gror mi ltung ba/ mi dang mi ma yin gyi bar chad kyis mi tshugs pa/ chos ldan gyi bsam don 'grub pa/ myur du 'tshang rgya ba stoganas skabs dang mthar thug

39gi phan sku/na brgyad dran pa'i lha/ nas dus drug tu skyabs 'bo bya zhing / dus dang rnam pa thams cad du masnu ga gsum la cwa khel bar byacad/ de ltar byed nus par bla ma lhas byin gyis brlab tu gasku la/ gnyis pa ni/de ltar skyabs su sku nga ba tsam gyis mi chog par ngan 'gro'i 'jigs pa las lha/ba byed kyi thabs dathoras las 'bras kyi blang thodar la 'jug dbo sa pas/ rgyu dge ba spyad pa las 'bras bu bde ba kho na 'byung zhing sdug bsngal mi'abyung /rgyu mi dge ba spyad pa las 'bras bu sdug bsngal khe na 'byung zhing bde ba mi 'byung / dge jig phra mo tsam las kyang 'bras bu bde sdug shin tu chen po 'byung / bde sdug myong ba'i rgyur gyur pa'i las ma bsags na/ las de'i 'bras bu bde sdug gtan nas mi cadang zhing / dge sdig gi las bsags pa gegs byed dang ma phrad na bskal pa brgya 'das kyang chud ci/za bar 'bras bu bde sdug nges par 'byin/ des na da lta bla ma'i bka' drin las dge sdig gi blang dor cung zad shes pa'i gnas skabs 'dir spang blang ma nor bar byed dgos par 'dug cing / de yang sgogasum gyi dge cisadakhekho las che so/nga ngam rags pa rnams gnad bsdus tedakar nagagi las lam bcuragasungs pa rnams kyigazhi dang /

40bsam pa dang / sbyor ba dang / mthar thug gi khyad par rnams dang / las so so'i lci yang gi khyad par dang / zhing dang / rten dang / dngos po dang / bsam pa'i sgo nas las stobs che bar 'gyur tshul dang / 'phen byed dang / rdzogs byed kyi dbye ba dang / byas pa dang / bsags pa'i khyad par dang / de dag las rnam smin dang / rgyu mthun dang / bdag wa'i 'bras bu cung zad kyang ma 'chol bar 'byung ba'i tshul rnams la nges pa brtan wa zhed par bya zhing / de yang shes pa tsam gyis mi chog par lag len du khel dgos pas/nyin mtshan kunatu sgogasum gyi spyod pa la so sor brtags te mi dge bcu la sogs pa'i kha na ma chod ba rnams la kun sdugang tsam yang mi rgyu bar sdusam sems mang du bsten nas goms par bya zhing / lus ngag yid gsum gyi dge ba phra mo tshun chad la mi brnyas par bre gsog phul gsog gi sgo nas bsgrub pa la 'bad/ gal te bag med pa dang nyon mongs mang ba sogs kyi dbang gis jig ltung byung na yang ji mi snyam par mi 'jog par/ ltung ba phyir bcos tshul sdom gsum so so'i bslab bya las gsungs pa ltar dang /jig pa phyir bcas pani rjobs bzhi'i sgogis bya dgos pas/jig pa'i shesadarigs

41drananas 'gyod pa drag wa sed pa rnam par sun 'byin pa'i 〉bso dang / slan chad srog la babs kyang nyes spyod la mi 'jug snyam du sdom pa nyes pa las slar sdog pa'i stobs dang / skyabs 'gro dang byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa rten gyi stobs dang / sher phyin sogs mdo sde zab snu swā/ga pa/ stong nyid la mos shing yid ches pa/ yig brgya sku/gas gzungs sngags zab ces bzla ba/sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs bzhengs pa/ dkon mchog mchod pa la brtson pa/ sangs rgyas byang sems kyi mtshan bcadad pa sogs gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs rnams ci nus su bsten pa ste gzhan gyi lad mo dang / khral chos tsam du ma song bar gnyen po stobs bzhi'i gnad tshang ba'i bshags bsdam shugs drag la rgyun ring ba jig pa dag pa'i mtshan ma brtan po ma byung gi bar du bya ba la 'bad pani/ bdag cag las dang po ba rnams la blo dang 'tsham zhing skabs su babs la med du mi rung ba'i nyams len gyigatso bo yin pas ci nas kyang 'bad par bya/ khyad par du theg pa mchog gi lam bzang bsgrub pa la/ tshe dang / kha dog dang / rigs dang / dbang phyug phun sum tshogs pa/ cig btsun pa/ dbang che bar grags pa/ skyes pa nyid dang / stobs

42dang ldan pa ste rnam smin gyi yon tan brgyad dang ldan pa'i rten khyad par can zhig thob na lam sgom pa'i sa chod gzhan dang mi 'dra ba zhig 'ong bar gsungs pas/ yon tan de dag gi rgyu/sems can la mi 'tshe ba dang / mar me la sogs pa'i snang ba dang gos gsar ba sbyin pa dang / gzhan la bran ltar gus par bya ba dang / ma〉sgrog dman gyi zhing sku1 byad med pa la zasalo1sa sogs sbyin pa dang / ngag gi mi dge ba bzhi sgong ba dang / bla ma mchog gsum pha ma sogs mchod pa dang / skyes pa'i yon tan la rang gzhan dga' zhing 'dun par byed padang / gzhan gyi bya ba'i grogs byed cing bza' btung ster ba ste rnam smin gyi rgyu brgyad sogs rgyu tshogs tshang bar bsgrubs te phyi mar ngan 'gro'i skye stsokhogs shing dal 'byor gyi rten bzang rnam par dag pa bar ma chad du 'thob pa'i gdeng dang ldan pa zhig bya'o/ de ltar byed nus par bla ma lhas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/༈ sheskuraXsgongatshadang thun snunang nga:ri rtasgomakhangababa'i11 sbyang ba la gnyis/ thar pa don gnyer gyi blo bskyed pa dang / thar par bgrod pa'i lam gyi rang bzhin gtan ladabab pa'o/ dang rgolaganyis/sdug bden 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsam pa/ kun 'byung 'khor ba'i

43'jug rim bsam pa'o/ dang po ni/ de ltar 'chi ba rjes su dran zhing / shi nas ngan 'gror ltung ba'i tshul bsam ste/ skyabs 'alo/ dang las 'bras kyi nyams len la 'bad pas bde 'asku'i bon 'phang 'alnga ba snu/da kyang / 'khe ra ba'i gnas kyi phun snu gas ci tsam thob kyang yid brtan med cing / las ༄/na gyi gzhan dbang du gyur pa'i sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin las ma 'das te/ ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal bcad glags med pa lta ci blos/ mir skyes kyang skye rga na 'chi dang / dgra mi sdug pa dang phrad pa dang /gnyen sdug pa dang bral ba dang / 'dod pa btsal kyang mi rnyed pa dang / mi 'dod pa 1/ga tu babs pa dang /cadar yod pa gasku/ga srung dang / med pa 'tshol 'gro dang / bkres sgom dang / ngal ba'i sdug bsngal du ma myong / lha ma yin rnams lha'i dpal 'byor la mi bahwa da pa'i phrag chadag gis yid gdung zhing de la brten nas lha dang 'thab pa'i sdug bsngal myong / 'dod lha rnams kyang 'chi 'pho ba'i tshe 'chi ltas lnga mthong ba'i mya ngan gyis yid gdung ba dang / gnas 'og mar ltung ba dang / lha ma yin dang 'thab pa sku/gas kyi sdug bsngal snu/nga / khams bo/nga ma gnyis su sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal med kyang / las ྅ na gyi 'ching ba las

44ma bo/la bas/ las bzang wa'i 'phen pa zad nas rang dbang med par ngan 'gro sogs su ltung ba ste/ mdor na 'khor ba'i bde 'byor ci tsam la longs spyad kyang mthar nges par 'dor dgos pas phun tshogs thob pa la yid brtan med/ dgra gnyen 1/gas phan tshun 'gyur nas 'alog bas phan gathe/da byed pa la yid brtan med/ yang dang yang du lus grangs med pa 'dor dgos pas lus thob pa la yid brtan med/ 'jig rten pha rol tu rang nyid gcig pur 'grodagos pas thogs layid brtan med/thog med nas yang yang nying 'tshams sbyar bas skye ba'i mtha' macan pa med/ 'khor ba'i bde ba la ci tsam spyad kyang ngoms pa med par sred pa ches cher 'phelate sdug bsngal mi bzad pa du ma la sbyor bar byed/ 'khor ba'i gnas kyi zag bcas kyi tshor ba bde ba rnams ni sdug bsngal snga ma re 'gag nas phyi ma re skyes pa la bde bar bzung ba tsam mgatogasayun ring brtenata mthar sdug bsngal du 'gyur bas ngo bo nyid kyi bde ba ma yin gyi/ 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal sha stag yin/ zag bcas nyer len gyi phung po 'di nyid las nyon snga ma'i gzhan dbang du gyur cing sdug bsngal dnganyon mongs phyi ma skyed pa'i sa wan rjes su 'brel bas tshe

45 'di'i sdug bsngal gyi rten byed cing phyi ma phan chad kyi sdug bsngal rnams 'dren par byed/ des na nyer len gyi phung wa'i khur 'di dang ma bral gyi bar du bde ba'i go skabs cung zad kyang med pas las nyon gyi gzhan dbang du song ba'i khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin can gyi nyer len gyi phung po 'di la nad dang /'bras dang / zug rngu ltar mthong ba'i skyo ba shugs drag po skye bar bla ma lhas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ gnyis pa ni/ de lta spu'i 'khor ba 'grub pa'i rgyu la las thon gnyis las/nyon mongs med na las tsam gyis srid par 'phen cisanus shing /snyan ce/ngas modata las sngar bsags med kyang de ma thag gsog par 'gyur bas na nyon mongs gtso bo yin/ de yang 'jig ltas bdag tu bzung ba na bdag gzhan ris su bcad nas rang phyogs la chags pa dang / gzhan phyogs la sdang ba dang / nga rgyal dang /phrag dog sogs nyon mongs sna tshogs pa skye zhing / de'i dbang gis bsku/da nams ma yin pa'i mi dge ba'i las dang / 'dod pa'i lha mir 'phen byed bsod nams kyi lasadang / khamasagong mar 'phen byed kyi mi gasku/ ba'i las bsags te/ shi nas bar do 'grub cing srid par nying mtshams sbyor ba sogs skye 'chi'i

46'khe ra 'o/ rgyud mar bas ra dbo sa pa'i tshul la zhib tu bsams nas nges par 'byung ba'i rmyo ci skye bya/ gzhan yang rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi dbang du byas na/ mir skye ba lta bu la thog mar de kho na nyid la rmongs pa'i ma rig pa'i dbang gis mir skye ba 'phen pa'i 'du byed kyi las bsags pa'i bag chags rgyu dus kyi rnam shes la balha/sa pa/ sred len gnyis kyis ga11sa btab pas bag chags de yang srid 'dren pa'inus pa mthu can gyi srid pa'iwa bor song ba'i dbangagis yang srid du nying mtshams sbyar ba skye ba'i rten 'brel dang / de dus kyi rnam shes ni 'bras dus kyi rnam shes yin zhing/ de nas ming gzugs/ skye mched/ reg cho ra rnams rim bzhin grub nas bde sdug snu nga ba'i mthar rga shis 'alhu mas par 'gyur ba lta bus mcho na nas ྅/na mo ngas gsum dang las gnyis dang sdug bsngal bdun snga phyi'i go rim mtha' gcig tu nges pa med par mgal me dang / cad chun lta bur 'khe ra ba'i tshul la nges pa rnyed par byasate nyes can bathon rwa la zhen pa 'og pa lta bu'i thobathos ma mayin pa zhig skye bdang / mi 'dod pa'i sdug bsngal de thams cad skyed par byed pa'i phung mo la thams cad kyi mab ni/ lnga ga ma med pa nas rang gi snying

47laganas pa'ijozhe snungs rnams yin par shes par byas la dgra bo'i dwangs mar bltas te nyon mongs so so'i mtshan nyid dang skye ba'i rgyu rnams shes pa'i 〉( nas ma mtha' yang ྅rten cesangs pa'i kha mi'edzen phyogs miskyor bar gshen wa'i phyogs bzung stedagra'i mthar thug thozhe mongs pa'i g.yul las myur du rgyal ba zhig byed nus par bla ma lhas byin gyis brlab tu gasku/la/ gnyis ba ni/de ltar sdug bden gyi nyes dmigs dang / kun 'byung gi sgo nas 'khor bar 'jug rim rnams bsam pa na 'khor ba'i rgyu las nyon bzlog dgos par mthong la/ bzlog pa'i thabs kyi gtso bo lam bslab pa gsum yin zhing / de'i nang nas kyang tshul khrims kyibaslab pa ni sku1natan thams cad kyi gzhi ma yin pas/khas blangs pa'i 11 thar gyi bslab pa'i bcas mtshams phra snusatshun chad mig 'bras bzhin du srung ba la 'bad cing / de yang ltung ba 'byung ba'i sgo bzhi las/ mi shes pa'i gnyen dzestor bslab bya mnyan pa dang / bag med pa'i gnyen por dran shes ngo tsha khrel yod bsten pa dang / ma gusapa'i gnyen por ston pa dang /de'i bcas pa dang / tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa rnams la gus par bya ba dang /nyon mongs mang ba'i gnyen por rang

48rgyud la brtags te ྅/na snu/ngasagang shas che ba laganyen sngo 'bad nas bsten pa'i ༄/ nas tshul khrims rnam par dag pa'i gdeng tshad thob pa zhig bya/ gal srid ltung bas gos kyang phyir bcos kyi rim pa bshad cho da ltar bya ba la 'bad nas phyin chad las thodan gyi gzhan dbang du mi 'bo ba'i thar pa dam pa'i btsan sa rten 'di'i steng nas zin pa zhig byed nus par bla ma lhas byin gyis brlab tu gasku/la/lha gsum ba skyes bu chen bo'i lam gyi rim ba la blo sbyang ba la gnyis/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i tshul dang / sems bskyed nas spyod pa la slob pa'i tshul lo/ dang po la gnyis/ rgyu 'bras man ngag bdun dang / bdag gzhan mnyam brje'i sgo nas sems bskyed tshul lo / dang bo ni/de ltar thar pa don gnyer gyi blo bathos ma ma yin pa'i lha/ nas lam bslab pa gsum la bslabata 'khe/ra ba las thar pa tsam 'thob snud kyang /de tsam gyis rangagazhan gyidonagangasang mthar phyin rikhus par ma zadagazhanadonayal b.raboranas rang nyid gcig pu ci thar byas na de las khrel chung ba med pas/sems can thams cad kyi don khur du 'khyer ba'i bsam pakhyad par can bskyed dgos/ de la thog mar sems can thams cad

49la sems snyams pa sgrub dbo sa pas 'di ltar bsam tshe sems can gyi ngos nas bde ba 'dod cing sdugabasngal mi 'dod par mtshungs pas/ 'ga' zhig la phan 'asnga gas shing 'ga' zhig la gasnyad pa byed par mi rigs la/ rang gi ngos nas thog med nas sems can rnams yang dang yang du bdag gi gnyen du ma gyur pa gcig kyang med pas chags sdang gis tso gas ris su gathe da pa ga la rigs/ rnam pa gcig tu na dgra gnyen thams cad myur du 'gyur nas 'thod bas rang gzhan rnams phan tshun dgra dang gnyen du lan mang sngo/ra gyur tshul bsamasanas chags sdang bkag ste sems sgoms par bya'o/ de ltar sems can la chags sdang gis ris su mi gcod par ma zad sems can thams cad bdag gi gnyen du gyur pa sha stag yin pas bsnobar bya bar rigs te/ 'kho ra ba la jo ga ma med pas/ bdag gi skye ba la yang lnga ga ma med cing skye shi brgyud mar byas te 'khe ra ba na lus 'di ma blangs bya ba dang / phyogs 'dir ma skyes bya ba med pas/ sems cad re res kyang bdag gi ma ma byas bya ba gcig kyang med cing byas pa la grangs kyis mi chod/ ma nam byas pa'i dus su ma rang gis nus chod dang bstun rnga/'i phan bde

50thams cad bsgrubs/ gcadad pa thams cad las bskyabs/ bu nabadang 'chi ba las rang nab dang 'chi babasam pa thag panas 'dam zhing / sdig sdug gtam ngan dang / rang srog la ma 'dzems par bsags pa'i zas thergar thams cad kyis bskyangs pa sogs tshe 'di'i mas ji ltar bskyangs pa bzhin du drin gyis bskyangs pas drin shin tu che/de lta bu'i drin can gyi mde rnams nyon snungs pa'igadon gyisasmyo zhing / macan mthodang nges legs kyi lam lta ba'i mig dang bral/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi so/nga khrid ni med/ skad cig re re bzhin nyes spyod kyi gom pa brdeg 'cha' bzhin du 'khor ba spyidang khyad par ngan 'gro'igayangakhar 'grim pa 'di rnams rtsis med du dor nas rang nyidagacig pu ci thar byas na khrel med kyi bya ba yin pas/ ma rgan de rnams 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa las sgrol zhing thar pa dam pa'i bde ba la 'thod pa'i drinagazo zhig bdagagis this kyang byadashog/des na bde bas phongs shing sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba'i sems can 'di thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu thams cadadang ldanata ci ma rung ldan par gyur cig ldan par cis kyang bya'o/ sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu thams cad dang bralan ci ma rungan

51 bral bar gyur cig bral bar cis kyang bya'o/ de ltar bde ba la 'god pa dang sdug bsngal las sgrol ba'i khur bdag la ma babs na su la babs pas bdag gcig pus mar gyur sems can thams cad sdug bsngal mtha' dag las sgrol zhing zag med kyi bde ba phun sum tshogs pa la cis kyang 'god par bya'o/ de yang da lta bdag la de lta bu'i nus pa med la/ der ma zad nyan rang dgra bcom pa gnyis kyi bo 'phang thob kyang sems can mtha' yas pa'i don rdzogs par byed pa'i nus pa med/ de lta bu'i nus pa su la sku/da na yang dag par ༄pags pa'i sangs rgyas nyag gathig la sku/da pa'i tshul gyis sku gsung thugs kyi sku/na tan rnams dran par byasate rangagazhan gyidon mthar phyin pa la/ go 'phang de 'thob pa med du mi rung par 'dug pas bdag gis ma sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che myur ba nyid du ci nas kyang 'thob par bya'o/ de ltar byed nus par bla ma lhas byin gyis brlab tu gasku/la/ni/gzhanayangabadagagazhan thams cadabadeba'adod cing sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa mnyam na yang rang cag rnams thog ma med pa nas rmi lam gyi gnas skabs tshun chad du rang gces

32par bzung zhingagazhan yal bar dorate rang nyid bde ba'i thabs tshul 'ba' zhig sgosna tshogs nas bsgrubs kyang / phyi phyir sdug bsngal myong ste ngal ba don med du gyur/ thub pa'i dbang pos rākha pa lam gyi gnas skabs su rang yal bar dor zhing gzhan gces par bzung ste gzhan don 'ba' zhig mdzad pas mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa yin/ mthe ra na gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi rgud pa dang sdug bsngal ji snyed yod pa thams cad rang gces 'dzin las 'byung zhing / 'phral yun gyi phan bde legs tshogs thams cad gzhan gces par 'dzin pa las 'byung bar 'dug pas deng phyin chad gces 'dzin gyi blo gnyis go sa brjesate rangagaces par 'dzin pa'i chogasar du mibaskyed cing/ skyes kyang rgyun 'thud du mi'ajug paragazhanagacesa'adzin gyi thom skyes pa bskyed cing skyes zinagonganasagongadu 'phel bar byas la ma sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngaladang jig sgrib thams cad bdag gi rgyud steng du blangs/ bdag gi bde dge legs snu gas thams cad sems can thams cad la bsam pa thag pa nasagatang bar bya'o/ de lta bu'i gzhan don rdzogs par bsgrub pa'i phyiradu rtsogs pa'i sangs rgyas kris/ 'phang bdag gis

53cis kyang 'thob par byacad/ de ltar byed nus par bla ma lhas byin gyis brlab tu galha/la/ skabs 'dir sems bskyed chogs gzung bar 'dod na/ smon sems rkyang ba'am smon 'jug cig char du len pa'i dmigs rnam gsal bar byas te/ bla ma thub pa'i dbang lnga'i rjes su zlos par mos nas/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' kun/ /bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ /ji ltar nyon gyi bde gshegs kyis/ /byang chub thugs ni bskyed pa dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la/ /de dag rim bzhin gnas pa ltar/ /bdag kyang 'gro la phan donadu/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed bgyi zhing //byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la/ /rim pa bzhin du bslab par bgyi/ lanagasum brtsod pas sgom pa thob par mos/ yang na sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma tshar gsum 'don pas kyang rung /deng dus bdag tshe 'bras bu yod/ /mi yi srid pa legs par thob/ /de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ /sangs rgyas sras su da gyur rke(//da ni bdag gis ci nas kyang / /rigs dang mthun pa'i las brtsams te/ /skyon med btsun pa'i rigs 'di la/ /rnyog par mi 'gyur de ltar bya/ zhes spro ba skyed pa yang bya/ de lta bu'i smon pa byang chub kyi sems tshe 'dir mi nyams shing 'phel ba'i phyir

54du sems bskyed kyi phan skusten dran nas nyin mtshan dus drug tu sems bskyed pa dang / sems can sdudas mi thodang zhing snu gas gnyis gasku/ga pa la bslab/ skye ba gzhan du sems bskyed dang mi 'bral ba'i phyir du nag wa'i chos bzhi sgong ba ste/ bla ma dang mkhan slob sogs rdzun gyis dbu bskor ba dang / gzhan dge ba byed pa la 'gyod pa bskyed pa dang / byang sems la zhe sdang gis skur ba 'debs pa dang / gasku/ sgyus sems can bslu ba rnams las ldog par bya zhing / de dag gi gnyen por rim pa bzhin shes bzhin du rdzun smra ba 1/nga ba/ sems can gzhan theg chen la ci nus su gzhug pa/ byang sems la ༄/na pa dang 'dra ba'i 'du shes bskyed cing bsngags pa brjod pa/ gzhan la gasku sgyu mi byed par bsam pa drang thodas gnas pa ste dkar wa'i cesas bzhi bsten pa la sogs pa'i bslab bya rnams la tshul bzhin du bslab par bya'o/ de ltar byed nus par bla ma lhas byin gyis brlab tu gasku/la/gnyis pa la gnyis/ theg chen spyi la slob tshul dang / khyad par du rdo rje theg pa la slob tshul lo/ dang bo la gnyis/ rgyal sras kyi spyod pa spyi la slob tshuladang / khyad par du phar phyin tha ma gnyes la slob tshul lo/

55dang bo ni/de ltar sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas 'thob par 'dod pa'i bsam pa bzang ba tsam gyis mi comag par/ de 'thob byed kyi thabs byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rlabs wa ཿ thams cad kyi gnad bsdus pa pha rol tu phyin pa drug la bslab par bya dbenas pas/ bsam pa rnam par dag pa'i sbru/ nas gang la gang 'tshams kyi dam pa'i snumis phyin ci ma so/ga par lha na pa cesas kyi sbyin pa dang / mi dang mi ma yin dang 'byung ba'i gcadad pa las skyob pa mi 'jigs pa'i sbyin pa dang / lan dang rnam par smin pa la re ba med par ji ltar 'os pa'i yo byadagatong bar byed pa zang zing gi sbyin pa ste mdor na lus dang longs spyod dge masogs bsnga ga pa'i dacadas sngo/ thams cad sems can thams cad la phangs pa med par galta nga ba'i sems pa yang dang yang du goms pa byasnyan/ mi dge ba bcu la sku/gas pa'i bcas rang gi kha na ma tho ba spong ba'i sdom pa'i tshul khrims dang / phyin drug la sogs pa'i dge ba ma skyes pa bskyed cing / skyes zin spel bar byed pa dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims dang / sems can gyi don bya ba bcu gcig la sogs pa'i lhags snrin be/la gyi lam la 'bend pa sems can ro/na byed kyi tshul khrims rnams la tshul

56bzhin du bslab par bya'o/khong khro'i nyes dmigs dang bzod pa'i phan yon bsam ste gnod byed la khro ba'i sems mi bskyed par phan pa sgrub pa gnod byed la ci mi snyam pa'i bzod pa dnganalus sems la mi 'dod pa'i sdug bsngal byung ba na/de la brten nas las ngan 'dag cing nges 'byung dang snying rje sogs skye bas 'do pa'iganas su bltasate sa bsadang du kho pa'i bar pa dnganadathon mthog gsum dang bdag med gnyis dngagalas 'bras dang /sangs rgyas byang sems kyi mthu bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang /byang sems kyi bslab pa'i gnas sku/gas la snying thag pa nas mos pa'i blo sbyong ba/chos la nges sems kyi bzod pa rnams la bslab par bya'o/bya ba ngan pa la chags pa dang /nyid lug cing zhum pa'i le lo sogs bkag stodage ba'i bya ba de la 'dun pa bskyed pa mos pa'i stobs dang /bya ba de la brtags nas 'jug cing brtsams pa mthar phyin par byed pa brtan pa'i stobs dang /ngoms pa med par 'jug pa dga' ba'i stobs dang /lus sems dub pa na ngal gsos te yang brtson 'grus rtsom pa dor ba'i dobs bzhi brten pa'i ༄gigabaskal chen grangs medagasum bye ba phrag 'bum 'gyur du sems canagacigagi sdug

57bsngal bsal ba'i phyir du dmyal ba kho nar gnas nas sangs rgyas sgrub dgos na'ang spro bar byed na/ yun de las thung ba sku gas lta ci sdu/sa pa la ba'i bsam pa'i stobs bskyed pa lo| cha'i tab brtson 'grus dang / rang rgyud la zab pa dang rgya che ba'i dge ba'i chos sdud pa'i brtson 'grus dang / sems can gzhan yang tshul der 'god pa la spro ba'i sems can don byed kyi brtson 'grus rnams la bslab par byacodi/ gzhan yang shin sbyangs la brten nas tshe 'dir lus sems bde bar gnas par byed pa dang /mngon shes/ rnam thar/ zad par/ zil gnon sogs kyi lo1na tan sgrub pa'i bsam gtanadang / bsamagatan gyi sbru1nas sems can gyi don sgrub par byed pa sogs zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gis bsdus pa'i 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'ibasamagatan rnams layangabaslab par bya'o/ gnas lugs bdag med pa'i de khon nyid phyin ci ma 'og par rtogs pa'i shes rab dang / rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa'i kun rdzob rtogs pa'i shes rab dang / sems can gyi 'di phyi'i don kha na ma tho ba med par sgrub tshul shes pa'i sems can gyi don bya ba rtogs 4 pa'i shes rab rnams layang bslab par bya'o/dedag gi skabs

58suyang rang de la hob bzhinadu gzhan de la 'ashod bdedangade'i sbyin pa dang / dman pa'i yid byed sdom pa'i tshul khrims dang /gzhan gyi gnod pa dang / sdug bsngal bzod pa dang / dge ba de spel ba'i phyir 'dun pa bskyed pa'i brtson 'grus dang /rdzogs pa'i byang chubatu rtsegacig tu bathoba'i bsam gtan dang / 'khor ga sum sgyu ma lta bur shes pa'i shes rab ste phar phyin drug tshang ba dang / rten dam pa byang chub kyi sems kyis kun nas bslang ba / dngos po dam pa sbyin sogs rang rang gi khyad par mtha' dag la slob par 'asnga da pa/ ched du bya ba dam pa sems can gyi phan bde ma lus pa bsgrub pa'i phyir du dmigs pa/ thabs la mkhas padam pa bdag med pa'i lta bas zin pa/ ba༄ladam pa dge mardzogs pa'i byang chubatu bathob/ rnam par dag pa dam pa sgrib gaphyis 'gog pa'i byed las can du gyur pa stodam pa drug ldan du byas nas nyams su len zhing / mkhe/ ba spyin pas sems can rnams 'khe ra du bsdus te phyin drug las brtsams pa'i chos snyan par smra ba dang / 〉〉sa bstan pa'i casan ྅7da pa'am nyams su len du 'jug pa dang / rang yang de ltar slob pa'i don mthun pa ste bsdu ba rnam pa bzhi'i sgo nas sems can thams cad smin

59grol gyi lam la 'god par bya'o/ de ltar byed nus par bla ma lhas byin gyis brlab tu ga31la/gnyis pa laganyis/zhi gnas la bslab pa'i tshul dang / lhag mthong la bslab pa'i tshul lo/ dang po ni/ khyad par du yang theg pa gsum gyi spogatan thams cad kyi gzhi rten ting nge 'dzen skyon med bsgrub pa la 'bad par bya ste/ 'gal rkyen dang bral zhing mthun rkyen tshang ba'idaben pa'i gnas su/ tshul khrims sogasating nge 'dzin gyi tshogs la gnas te/ lus gnad dang ldan pas basbru/ma par bya la/ zhi gnas kyi dmigs rten bzhi po gang rung ngam/ sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa sku/gas kyi dasprosas pa mang bas de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku la dmigs par bya/ de yang blo ngor ci tsam shar ba'i rtsaba'i dmigs rten la rtsegacig tu dmigs nas dran pa'i rgyun bskyangasate bsgrubadagos shing /thog marating nge 'dzin la sbyor ba'i tshe le lo nyes pa yin pas/ de'i gnyen po ting nge 'dzin gyi yon tan mthong ba'i dad pa dang / 'dun pa dang /brtson 'grus dang / shin sbyangs rnams yin la/ting nge 'dzin la ba63 pa'i tshe dmigs pa brjed pa nyes pa yin pas/ de'i gnyen 1/ra dmigs rten mi brjed par dran pa dang / mnyam

60par bzhag pa'i tshe bying lha da nye sa pa yin pas/ de'i gnyen 1/ra bying cadad byung ba'am 'byung bar nye ba na 'phral du rig pa'i shes bzhin dang / bying rgod byung ba'i tshe 'du mi byed pa nyes pa yin pas/ de'i gnyen por de thong ba'i 'du byed dam sems pa dang /bying rgod dang bral ba'i tshe 'du byed pa nyes pa yin pas/ de'i gnyen por 'du mi byed pa'i btang sgoms rnams bsten dgos la / de yang sems dmigs rten las gzhan du mi 'a'o/ yang /gsal dngas kyi cha gnyis ka med pa bying ba rags pa dang /dwangs cha yod kyang gsal cha'i ngar med pa bying ba 'bring dang /dwangs gsal gyi cha gnyis ka sku/da kyang 'dzin stangs kyi gsal cha'i ngar cung zad zhanadu song ba bying ba phra mosan zhingan gzhan yang bying rmugs gnyis kyi khyad par dang / 'phro rgod gnyis kyi khyad par rnams kyang shes par byas nas 'dzin stangs kyigasal ngar yod pa'i tshe rig pa 'phang bstod drags na rgod pa skye la/gnas cha byung tshe ma bsgrims par ha cang tā da na bying ba shas che bar 'gyur bas/ rang nyams la dpag ste bsgrims lhod kyi mtshams zin pa'i lhurto nas sems dmigs pa la 'arostogs pa'i gnas cha 'asnu la ba dang / gsal cha'i ngar 'don paganyis res

61snu sa su bskyang bar bya/ de ltar wa/mas pas rim gyis sems 'jog pa dang / rgyun du 'jog pa dang / glan te 'jog pa dang /nye bar 'jog pa dang / dul bar byed pa dang / zhi bar byed pa dang / rnam par zhi bar byed pa dang / rtsegacig tu byed pa dang / mnyam par 'a15ga pa ste sems gnas dgu rim gyis 'grub cing / de dag kyang rim pa bzhin sems gnas dang sngo/ 1/sa pa dngan gnyis pa bsam pa dngan gsum pa bzhi pa gnyis dran pa dang / lnga pa drug pa gnyis shes bzhin dang / bdun pa brgyad pa gnyis brtson 'grus dang / dgu pa 'dris pa'i stobs kyis 'grub lugs dang / sems gnas dang 1/ gnyis kyi dus su 'bad pas bsgrim dbo sa pas bsgrims te 'jug pa dang / de nas sems lnga'e skabs su bying snyad kyis bar du gathodanus pas skabs gya'achad cing 'jug pa dang / sems brgyad pa lade ltar gcod mi nus pas skabs su 'chad pa med par 'jug pa dang /sems dgu pa lani bar yang mi'achad cing rtsol bayang rgyun par brten midagos pas rtsol ba med par 'jug pa'iyid byed 'jog tshul rnams kyang shes par bya/ de ltar balhu/mas pas sems dge ba la ci 'dod du bkol du rung ba'i sems shin sbyangs skye/

62de'i mthus lus kyi gnas ngan len dang bral nas las su rung ba'i rlung lus la rgyu bas lus shin sbyangs skye/ de dag la brten nas lus la bde ba'i nyams skye zhing /de las sems shin sbyangs kyi bde ba skye/ lus shin sbyangs skyes ma thag gi sems dga' yal yal ba yang rim gyis zhi nas ting nge 'dzin dang rjes su mthun pa'i shin sbyangs mi gaspong bas zin pa'i zhi gnas mtshan nyid pa bsgrub pa de la brten nas zhi rags kyi rnam pa can gyi lhag mthong b.rākhas nas 'jig rten pa'i lam gyis bsam gzugs brgyad sogs bsgrub pa'am/ bden pa'i rnam can gyi lhag mchodang bsgrubs te 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam gyis khams gsum gyi nyon mongs pa thong par byed pa stode lta bu'i zhi gnas kyiting nge 'dzin khyad par can myur du rgyud la skye bar bla ma lhas byin gyis brlab tu gasku la/gnyis pa ni/de lta bu'iting nge 'dzin la brtenanas bdag med shodags pa'i lhag masgyu nga gi rtogs pa bskyed dathodas pas/ lhag malnga nga gi tshogs kyi gatho rwab zab mo'i gzhung la jo sa bsam byed pa dang bsags sbyangs la 'bad pa dang / bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs dbyer med du byas te rtsegacigatu gsol ba 'debs

63pa rnams la 'bad par bya zhing / dngosagazhi lagang zag gobadag red gtan la phabanas sgom tshuladang / chos kyi bdag medagatan la phab nas sgom tshul dang gnyis/ dang po la gnad bzhi las/ gzhan gyis rang la phan gcad chen po byas pa lta spu'i che'am/thog babs pa'am/ g.yang sar ltung du nye ba lta bu'i rkyen las dga' ba'am 'jigs pa'i nyams chen sngo/ byung ba'i tshe/ nga nga snyam du dam spring sbring 'dzin pa 'byung zhing / de'i tshe ngar 'dzin lhan skyes kyi nga'i 'dzin tshul gsal bar yod pas shes pa byings blo de'i ngo bor bskyed bzhin du sdu'i cha shas phra mozhigagisade'i 'odzen tshul la brtags pa na/ phung po lnga'am lus sems so sor ma phye ba'i tshogs tsam gyi steng du mingagis btags pa la miltos par dang po nas tshugs thub tu grub pa'i nga zhig yod par 'dzin pa ni/ngar 'dzin lhan skyes kyis 'dzin tshul yin pas/ tshig gi rjes su 'brangs pa'i sgra spyi tsam ma yin par rgyud steng nas rjen char gyis ngos zin par bya bzhi/ dgag bya'i snang tshul nges pa'i gnad dang / des bzung ba ltar gyi nga de phung po lnga dang gcig dang tha dadagang rung lasagazhan du grub tshul gtananas misrid par thag bcad pa khyab pa nges pa'i gnad dang / des bzung ba ltar gyi

64nga de phung po lnga dang gcig tu yod na/ phung po lnga yod pa bzhin du bdag kyang rgyung tha dad pa lngar 'gyur ba'am/ nga gcig yin pa bzhin du phung po lnga yang gcig tu 'gyur ba dang /nye bar blang bya dang len pa lha/ yang gcig tu 'gyur bas bya byed thams cad gcig tu thal ba dang / phung po skye 'jig byed pa bzhin du nga yang skye'ajig byedadagos la/de ltaran bdag skad thig sngaphyishe rnams bden grub kyis tha dad du 'gyur bas las ma byas pa dang 'phrad padang/ byas pa chud za ba dang / skye ba dran pa ci/'thad pa sogs su 'gyur bas/ bdag phung rang bzhin gyis gcig tu ma grub snyam du nges pa bskyed pa gathig bral nges pa'i gnad dang / des bzung ba ltar gyi nga de phung po lnga dang tha dad du grub na phung po lnga lha/ lha/ra bsal ba'i rjes su nga 'o/gas su bstan rgyu sku da dbo/sa pa la de ltar mi 'dug pa dang / bdag la phung po'i mtshan nyid skye 'jig lha/gas med pas 'ching bo la sku/gas kyi bya byed gang yang mi 'thad par 'gyur ba lha/gas kyi rigs pas bdag phung bden pa'i tha dad du yang ma grub snyam pa'i nges pa bskyed bdu bral nges pa'i gnad de/ de dag la brten nas ngar 'dzin lhan skyes kyis bzung ba ltar gyi nga med par nges pa na nges shes de nyid kyi rgyun

65bying snyad dang bral bar rtsegacig tu skyong zhing nges shes kyi shugs zhan du songan sngar ltar rigs pas dpyad pa byas nas nges shes sor chud par bya ba dang / ha cang dpyad sgom mang bas gnas cha chungadu song na 'jog cas gyisaganas cha sor gzhug pa'idapyad 'jog spel mar byed cing de ltar yang yang bsgoms pas nges ngor rang bzhin med pa'i nges shes dam spring nge ba dang / snang ngor dgag bya bkag tsam gyis stong sang nge ba'i khyad par gnyis ldan du byas nas rtsegacig tu skyong ba mnyam bzha ga nam mkha' lta buliskyong tshul dang / delistobs kyis rjes thob tu gang shar thams cad snang yang bden par med pa sgyu ma lta bu'i rnam rol tu 'char ba la bslab par bya'o/ de ltar byed nus par bla ma lhas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ gnyis pa ni/de ltar gang zag gi steng du dpyad pa byed tshul de dang mthun par rang gi phung po sogs phyi nang cad bcud kyis bsdus pa'i 'dus byasadang 'dus ma byas kyi chos thams cad kyang rang rang gi cha shas chogs tsam gyi steng nas tshugs thub tu grub pa'i bden par 'dzin tshul nges pa dang / cha can de rnams rang rang gi cha shas rnams dngabakhig dang tha dad gang rung las gzhan du grub tshul med cing / gcig

bcog 66tu skru/ cha rnamasag dang cha //du marakhrurazlong go/tha dkātyādan cha shas /dris las sa subastan dudadas pa gas rigs pa kha pa nas ba༄khe zhing /gzhan yang gang zag gi bdag med sgrub byed rnam lnga dang rnam bdun gyi rigs pa dngachos kyibadag rnyo kṣiṃ byed mtha' bzhi'o skye'athog sogs kyi rigs pa dang /de thams cad rigs pa'i rgyal 1 3na 'brel sadashog nga /brtenanasabatagagapo'irtena'abreladang /rang bzhin med pa'i stong pa gnyis gzhi gcig gi steng du phan tsogacig gis gcig la go ba steng bas snang dong 'gal med grogs su 'char tshul shes par bya zhing /sngar bshad pa ltaradapyada'ago spelasaṃtshuladugoms par byasapas zhiganas la mnyam par bzhag phan dku nganganas bdag rnyo tsādon la rigs pasadapyad pa byas pasadapyad thebs kyis kyang shin sbyangasakyi dga' bde khyad par can 'bad med du 'dren nus pa byung ba na stong nyid la darigs pa'i zhi lhag zung 'brel thog mar tho pa yin zhing /bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po'i rgyab brten dang bcas te lam de'i rgyun goms par byas pas mnyam bzhag rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyis mthong sgom gyi spang bya rnams

67rim gyis sgong zhing / bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rgya chen po rnams myur du rdzogs par bya'o/ de ltar byed nus par bla ma lhas byin gyis brlab tu galha/la/gnyis ba khyad paratwa rdo rje theg pa la sgob tshul ni/de ltar lam thun mong ba de dag gis rgyud sbyangs nas tshe gcig nyid la sangs rgyas kyi sar bathod pa'i nye lam zab theg pa la 'jug par bya dgos pas/ sho je slob dpon mtshan nyid dang ldan pa las sku bzhi'i sa bon thebs nges kyi dbang bskur rnam par dag pa nod cing / de'i dus su khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa rig 'bras bzhin du bsrung ba gzhir bzung nas smin byed bskyed pa'i rim padang / thos byed rdzogs pa'i rim pa/ lam la thogs 'byin pa'i rje/da pa dang bcas pa la bslab pas/ snyigs dus kyi tshe thung 'di la zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang mngon du byasate ma rgan sems can thams cad gtan bde blan med pa'i sa la myur du 'god par bya'o/ de ltar byed nus par bla ma lhas byin gyis brlab tu galha/la/gsum pa mjug ji ltar bya gni/dus gsum skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma mchog /thub dbang rdo rje 'chang ra gsol ba

68'debs/ /rgyal ba dgyes pa'i lam bzang de dag rnams/ /myur du rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ zhes ci mang brjod cing gsol ba shugs drag tu btab pas/ spyi bo'i bla ma lha'i sku las rang 'dra gnyis pa zhig chadanas rang nyid lathim pas rang thub pa'i dbang wa'i skur gyur/ rang thub dbang du gsal ba'i sku las 'od zer 'phros/ mtha' lhar gyi sems can thams cad la 'og pas sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs te thub pe'i dbang wa'i go 'phang la bkod/ rang dang sems can thams cad thub pa'i dbang por gsal ba'i thugs gar zla ba'i steng du hūṃ yig ser wa'i mthar sngags phreng gis bsgor bar gyur/ omu nee mu nee mahā mu na ye swāhā/ zhes ci mang bzla/ dge ba 'di yisam/ bla ma sangs rgyasamo/ /'bo/ bamo/ de yi sa lamasku/ga ces dang /'jam dpal dpa' bo sogs shlauka gnyisadang / lam rim smin lam sogs bsngo smon rnam par dag pas rgyas gdab par bya'o/ gnyisaspru thun mtshams su ji ltar bya bani/ thun btang ba'itshedangos gzhi'idarigs rnam yal b.rador nas lhagasum rgyalanadu btangata thogs shin tu chung bas/ skabs su babs pa'i dmigs rnam yang yang gsal 'debs shing / de dag ston pa'i gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas
